_comment: Storyboard map for meta-create-skill VIDEO 6: How To Create A Skill (CP2's third explainer). 6 diagrams in teaching order, one column each, left to right. The through-line Rashid asked for (2026-07-26): a good skill starts with CLARITY ABOUT HOW YOU ALREADY WORK, not with prompting.
hard_rule: NO SUBFOLDER NAMES IN THIS DECK. Do not reintroduce workflows/, references/, scripts/ or assets/ as destinations here. Rashid, 2026-07-26: 'I don't want people to be confused with workflows assets and references — I just want them to know what to give.' Where each input gets filed is the AI's problem; naming the plumbing at the moment someone is being asked to DO something is what made it confusing. The folder anatomy is taught once, in v1-what-is-a-skill, and is not repeated here. The word 'assets' survives only as plain English for 'your real files', never as a folder path.
the_five_inputs: the steps, in the order you do them
your assets (the real files it works from)
the edge cases (exceptions + the other situations the same skill covers)
